stile: digital oil painting, fantasy storybook illustration, rich warm colors, soft cinematic lighting, painterly brush strokes, no text, no letters, no watermark

vlad.descrizione: Vlad, a 13-year-old boy with short messy dark brown hair, brown eyes, light freckles, slim build, friendly curious face; he wears a small dark metal feather-shaped pendant on a thin chain around his neck

vlad_armatura.descrizione: Vlad in his magical golden armor: polished golden plates with glowing runes, a glowing firebird feather emblem on the chest, golden helmet with a crest, warm orange glow between the plates; armor design changes with the situation but always golden with the firebird feather emblem

ludovica.descrizione: Ludovica, a 13-year-old girl with long wavy light brown hair, big expressive eyes, brave and quick, casual summer clothes

prof_siligato.descrizione: Professor Marcella Siligato, a friendly woman aged about 57 with short curly white hair (a pencil tucked into it), round glasses, kind lined face, warm smile, light shirt and long blue skirt

nonna_tanya.descrizione: Nonna Tatiana (Tanya), Vlad's grandmother, around 70, kind and mysterious, grey hair in a bun with a colorful Russian headscarf, warm wise eyes, embroidered cardigan, gentle smile
